title: Hip Fracture Characterization With Ultrasound Exam
brief_summary: Hip fractures are usually classified according to their X-ray as subcapital, pertrochanteric. We examine hip fractures with ultrasound in order to characterize the fractures with several parameters.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients over 50 years with x rays showing a hip fracture

Exclusion Criteria:

* previous fracture or surgical intervention in the hip
* fracture over 3 days old
* pregnancy
* flexion contracture of hip
